\begin{lexlean}{EventProtocol}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}

\importmodule{EventAdmission}

\begin{semanticmodule}

  name: PayloadRead,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [{name: value, type: EventAdmission::EventPayload}, {name: rest, type: Nat}]
}

  parameters: [],

definition{
  name: readPayload,
  parameters: [words : (List Nat), offset : Nat],
  result: (Option PayloadRead),
  body: (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words offset)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [PayloadRead])
    | Option.some kind => (if ((project kind value) =? 0) then (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project kind rest))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [PayloadRead])
      | Option.some value => (ctor Option.some [PayloadRead] (record PayloadRead {value := (ctor EventAdmission::EventPayload.natural (project value value)), rest := (project value rest)}))) else (if ((project kind value) =? 1) then (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project kind rest))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [PayloadRead])
      | Option.some value => (if ((project value value) <=? 1) then (ctor Option.some [PayloadRead] (record PayloadRead {value := (ctor EventAdmission::EventPayload.flag ((project value value) =? 1)), rest := (project value rest)})) else (ctor Option.none [PayloadRead]))) else (if ((project kind value) =? 2) then (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project kind rest))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [PayloadRead])
      | Option.some count => (if ((project count value) <=? 1024) then (let values : CompositionProtocol::NatsRead := (CompositionProtocol::readNats words (project count rest) (project count value) (nil Nat)); (if (project values valid) then (ctor Option.some [PayloadRead] (record PayloadRead {value := (ctor EventAdmission::EventPayload.bytes (project values value)), rest := (project values rest)})) else (ctor Option.none [PayloadRead]))) else (ctor Option.none [PayloadRead]))) else (ctor Option.none [PayloadRead])))))
}

definition{
  name: readContract,
  parameters: [words : (List Nat), offset : Nat],
  result: (Option ContractRead),
  body: (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words offset)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [ContractRead])
    | Option.some key => (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project key rest))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [ContractRead])
      | Option.some version => (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project version rest))
        | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [ContractRead])
        | Option.some kind => (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project kind rest))
          | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [ContractRead])
          | Option.some maximumBytes => (match (CompositionProtocol::listReferences words (project maximumBytes rest))
            | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [ContractRead])
            | Option.some producers => (match (CompositionProtocol::listReferences words (project producers rest))
              | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [ContractRead])
              | Option.some consumers => (ctor Option.some [ContractRead] (record ContractRead {value := (record EventAdmission::EventContract {key := (project key value), version := (project version value), kind := (project kind value), maximumBytes := (project maximumBytes value), producers := (project producers value), consumers := (project consumers value)}), rest := (project consumers rest)}))))))))
}

definition{
  name: readEnvelope,
  parameters: [words : (List Nat), offset : Nat],
  result: (Option EnvelopeRead),
  body: (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words offset)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [EnvelopeRead])
    | Option.some key => (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project key rest))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [EnvelopeRead])
      | Option.some version => (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project version rest))
        | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [EnvelopeRead])
        | Option.some generation => (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project generation rest))
          | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [EnvelopeRead])
          | Option.some sequence => (match (CompositionProtocol::readReference words (project sequence rest))
            | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [EnvelopeRead])
            | Option.some producer => (match (CompositionProtocol::readReference words (project producer rest))
              | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [EnvelopeRead])
              | Option.some consumer => (match (readPayload words (project consumer rest))
                | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [EnvelopeRead])
                | Option.some payload => (ctor Option.some [EnvelopeRead] (record EnvelopeRead {value := (record EventAdmission::EventEnvelope {key := (project key value), version := (project version value), generation := (project generation value), sequence := (project sequence value), producer := (project producer value), consumer := (project consumer value), payload := (project payload value)}), rest := (project payload rest)})))))))))
}

definition{
  name: encodeResult,
  parameters: [result : (Result Nat EventAdmission::EventError)],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match result
    | Result.error error => (match error
      | EventAdmission::EventError.invalidEventContract => 0x696e76616c69644576656e74436f6e7472616374
      | EventAdmission::EventError.invalidEventContext => 0x696e76616c69644576656e74436f6e74657874
      | EventAdmission::EventError.staleGeneration => 0x7374616c6547656e65726174696f6e
      | EventAdmission::EventError.staleSequence => 0x7374616c6553657175656e6365
      | EventAdmission::EventError.wrongEvent => 0x77726f6e674576656e74
      | EventAdmission::EventError.undeclaredRoute => 0x756e6465636c61726564526f757465
      | EventAdmission::EventError.invalidPayload => 0x696e76616c69645061796c6f6164
      | EventAdmission::EventError.compositionRejected reason => (prim append 0x636f6d706f736974696f6e52656a65637465643a (CompositionProtocol::encodeError reason) : Bytes))
    | Result.ok next => (prim append 0x6f6b20 (WorkProtocol::hexWord next) : Bytes))
}

definition{
  name: dispatchWords,
  parameters: [words : (List Nat)],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (CompositionProtocol::readPolicy words 0)
    | Option.none => 0x6d616c666f726d65644576656e74
    | Option.some policy => (match (CompositionProtocol::listFeatures words (project policy rest))
      | Option.none => 0x6d616c666f726d65644576656e74
      | Option.some features => (match (readContract words (project features rest))
        | Option.none => 0x6d616c666f726d65644576656e74
        | Option.some contract => (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project contract rest))
          | Option.none => 0x6d616c666f726d65644576656e74
          | Option.some generation => (match (CompositionProtocol::readScalar words (project generation rest))
            | Option.none => 0x6d616c666f726d65644576656e74
            | Option.some sequence => (match (readEnvelope words (project sequence rest))
              | Option.none => 0x6d616c666f726d65644576656e74
              | Option.some envelope => (if ((project envelope rest) =? (prim length words : Nat)) then (encodeResult (EventAdmission::admitEvent (project features value) (project policy value) (project contract value) (project generation value) (project sequence value) (project envelope value))) else 0x6d616c666f726d65644576656e74)))))))
}

definition{
  name: dispatchEvent,
  parameters: [bytes : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (32768 <? (prim length bytes : Nat)) then 0x6576656e74546f6f4c61726765 else (let decoded : CompositionProtocol::DecodedWords := (CompositionProtocol::decodeWords bytes 0 4096 (nil Nat)); (if (project decoded valid) then (dispatchWords (project decoded value)) else 0x6d616c666f726d65644576656e74))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: boundary,
  parameters: [],
  result: String,
  body: "Event wire v1 is event plus one ASCII space, then lowercase hexadecimal octets of little-endian uint32 words. The existing composition policy and feature list encoding is followed by contract key/version/kind/maximumBytes, producer and consumer reference lists, expected generation/sequence, envelope key/version/generation/sequence, producer and consumer references, and payload kind plus value. Payload kinds are natural=0 with one word, flag=1 with one canonical zero-or-one word, bytes=2 with a count and byte-valued words. Feature and route lists retain composition limits; byte payloads have at most 1024 entries. Maximum wire payload is 32768 ASCII bytes, 4096 words. Malformed/truncated/noncanonical/trailing data refuses before admission. Admission returns ok-space plus one hexadecimal uint32 next sequence, or an exact typed EventAdmission error; composition errors retain the compositionRejected prefix. The browser represents and validates protocol shapes but does not decide event admission. The caller must separately authenticate declarations/participants, compare and advance durable state and qualify delivery; a wire acceptance is not an executed effect."
}
